svg.text: AFD puts attention and FFN on different devices. DeepInfer runs both on every device and moves tokens only for the MoE experts.
AFD = Attention-FFN Disaggregation DP = data parallel EP = expert parallel
AFD (a design DeepInfer does NOT use): two pools of devices
Attention runs on one pool, the FFN (experts) on another pool. Hidden states cross between the pools in every layer.
only FFN or MoE expert layers
hidden states after attention, every layer
FFN output, back for the next layer
DeepInfer: every device runs attention AND the MoE layer
Attention is data parallel (each device has its own requests). Only the MoE layer sends tokens to other devices, and it sends them back.
own requests (DP rank 0) · own KV cache
own requests (DP rank 1) · own KV cache
own requests (DP rank 2) · own KV cache
own requests (DP rank 3) · own KV cache
DeepEP all-to-all: each token goes to the devices that hold its top-k experts (mlp.py:461-490)
DeepEP all-to-all: expert outputs return to the token's own device (mlp.py:493-511)
All device process groups use ONE backend: PLATFORM.distributed_backend = "nccl" or "hccl" (parallel_state.py:82-117). NCCL and HCCL cannot talk to each other.
What the docs DO split: vision encoder / prefill / decode (E/P/D)
Separate instances per stage, not per layer. P and D instances run the whole LLM; VE runs only the vision encoder. Not in this release.
README.md:41: "VE/Prefill/Decode disaggregation (most required engine functionality is already implemented)" is listed under "not included in this release".
Simplified: panel 2 shows 4 devices and one layer. Real decode uses EP64-128. Not shown: DeepInfer calls DeepEP with async_with_compute_stream=True (mlp.py:479, 507).
qa.md = doc/inference_deployment_qa.md. Attention uses data parallelism with #DP = #EP (qa.md:33).
